en.title: Volume of a Cylinder Calculator – Calculate Cylinder Volume
en.metaTitle: Volume of a Cylinder Calculator – Calculate Cylinder Volume
en.metaDescription: Calculate cylinder volume using radius, diameter, height, reverse dimensions, hollow shell pipes, or oblique cylinders with step-by-step formulas.
en.description: Calculate cylinder volume from radius, diameter, height, find missing height or radius from volume, hollow cylindrical shell pipe volume, and oblique cylinders.
en.shortDescription: Calculate cylinder volume, hollow shell volume, and missing dimensions instantly.
en.intro: Compute exact cylinder volume from radius and height, diameter, hollow shell dimensions, or reverse calculations with step-by-step mathematical proofs and fluid unit conversions.
en.formulaDescription: In Euclidean 3D geometry, the volume of a right circular cylinder is equal to the area of its circular base multiplied by its perpendicular height: V = π × r² × h. When diameter d is known, V = (π × d² × h) / 4. For a hollow cylinder (shell or pipe), V = π × (R² − r²) × h.
en.formulaEquation: V = π · r² · h  |  V = (π · d² · h) / 4  |  V = π · (R² − r²) · h  |  h = V / (π · r²)

workedExample.title: Worked Example: Cylinder with Radius 5 cm and Height 10 cm
workedExample.scenario: Calculate the geometric volume, surface area, and fluid capacity of a cylindrical container with radius r = 5 cm and perpendicular height h = 10 cm.
workedExample.calculation: Base Area A = π × r² = π × 5² = 25π ≈ 78.54 cm². Volume V = A × h = 25π × 10 = 250π ≈ 785.398 cm³. Fluid capacity = 0.7854 Liters.

faqs.question: What is the formula for the volume of a cylinder?
faqs.answer: The formula is V = π × r² × h, where V is volume, r is the radius of the circular base, and h is the perpendicular height. It represents the circular base area (πr²) multiplied by the height.

faqs.question: How do you calculate cylinder volume from diameter?
faqs.answer: Since diameter d = 2r, the radius is r = d / 2. Substituting this into the volume formula yields V = π × (d / 2)² × h = (π × d² × h) / 4.

faqs.question: How do you find the height of a cylinder when volume and radius are known?
faqs.answer: Rearrange the volume equation to solve for height: h = V / (π × r²). Divide the known volume by the area of the circular base (πr²).

faqs.question: How do you find the radius from volume and height?
faqs.answer: Rearrange the formula to isolate radius: r = √(V / (π × h)). Divide the volume by (π × h) and take the square root of the result.

faqs.question: How is the volume of a hollow cylinder (pipe or tube) calculated?
faqs.answer: Subtract the inner hollow cylinder volume from the outer cylinder volume: V = π × (R² − r²) × h, where R is the outer radius and r is the inner radius.

faqs.question: Does an oblique cylinder use a different volume formula?
faqs.answer: No. According to Cavalieri's Principle, an oblique cylinder has the exact same volume formula V = π × r² × h, provided h is the perpendicular distance between the parallel bases, NOT the slanted side length.

faqs.question: बेलन के आयतन का सूत्र क्या है?
faqs.answer: बेलन के आयतन का सूत्र V = π × r² × h है, जहाँ r वृत्ताकार आधार की त्रिज्या और h लंबवत ऊंचाई है।

faqs.question: व्यास से बेलन का आयतन कैसे ज्ञात करें?
faqs.answer: व्यास d = 2r होता है, इसलिए त्रिज्या r = d / 2 होगी। सूत्र में रखने पर V = (π × d² × h) / 4 प्राप्त होता है।

faqs.question: आयतन और त्रिज्या ज्ञात होने पर ऊंचाई कैसे निकालें?
faqs.answer: ऊंचाई निकालने के लिए सूत्र h = V / (π × r²) का उपयोग करें। आयतन को आधार क्षेत्रफल (πr²) से भाग दें।

faqs.question: खोखले बेलन (पाइप) का आयतन कैसे निकाला जाता है?
faqs.answer: खोखले बेलन का आयतन बाहरी बेलन के आयतन में से आंतरिक बेलन का आयतन घटाकर निकाला जाता है: V = π × (R² − r²) × h।

faqs.question: क्या तिरछे (oblique) बेलन का आयतन सूत्र अलग होता है?
faqs.answer: नहीं। कैवलिएरी के सिद्धांत के अनुसार तिरछे बेलन का आयतन भी V = π × r² × h होता है, बशर्ते h आधारों के बीच की लंबवत ऊंचाई हो।

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la fórmula para calcular el volumen de un cilindro?

faqs.question: ¿Cómo se calcula el volumen a partir del diámetro?

faqs.question: ¿Cómo se calcula el volumen de un cilindro hueco o tubo?

faqs.question: 円柱の体積を求める公式は何ですか？
faqs.answer: 円柱の体積公式は V = π × r² × h です。底面積（πr²）に垂直な高さ（h）を掛け合わせます。

faqs.question: 中空円柱（パイプ）の体積はどのように計算しますか？

stepByStep.title: Einheiten festlegen
stepByStep.instruction: Wählen Sie die Längeneinheit und die gewünschte Volumeneinheit.

stepByStep.title: Berechnen
stepByStep.instruction: Klicken Sie auf Berechnen, um das Volumen und den vollständigen Rechenweg zu sehen.

workedExample.title: Beispielrechnung: Zylinder mit Radius 5 cm und Höhe 10 cm
workedExample.scenario: Berechnung von Volumen und Fassungsvermögen eines Zylinders mit r = 5 cm und h = 10 cm.
workedExample.calculation: Grundfläche A = π × 5² ≈ 78,54 cm². Volumen V = 78,54 × 10 = 250π ≈ 785,398 cm³ (0,7854 Liter).

faqs.question: Wie lautet die Formel für das Zylindervolumen?
faqs.answer: Die Formel lautet V = π × r² × h, wobei r der Radius der kreisförmigen Grundfläche und h die senkrechte Höhe ist.

faqs.question: Wie berechnet man das Volumen eines Hohlzylinders?
faqs.answer: Man zieht das Innenvolumen vom Außenvolumen ab: V = π × (R² − r²) × h, wobei R der Außenradius und r der Innenradius ist.

pt.name: Calculadora de Volume de Cilindro
pt.title: Calculadora de Volume de Cilindro – Calcular Volume Cilíndrico
pt.metaTitle: Calculadora de Volume de Cilindro – Calcular Volume Cilíndrico
pt.metaDescription: Calcule o volume de cilindros a partir do raio, diâmetro, altura, cilindros ocos (tubos) ou cilindros oblíquos com passo a passo.
pt.description: Calcule o volume de cilindros retos, tubos ocos e resolva dimensões desconhecidas com fórmulas passo a passo e conversões.
pt.shortDescription: Calcule o volume de cilindros, tubos ocos e áreas superficiais instantaneamente.
pt.intro: Calcule com precisão o volume de cilindros regulares, tubos ocos e capacidades em litros e metros cúbicos com demonstrações completas.
pt.formulaDescription: O volume de um cilindro circular reto é igual à área de sua base circular multiplicada pela altura perpendicular: V = π × r² × h. Com diâmetro d: V = (π × d² × h) / 4. Para cilindros ocos: V = π × (R² − r²) × h.
pt.formulaEquation: V = π · r² · h  |  V = (π · d² · h) / 4  |  V = π · (R² − r²) · h  |  h = V / (π · r²)

stepByStep.instruction: Selecione Raio e altura, Diâmetro e altura, Achar altura, Achar raio, Cilindro oco ou Cilindro oblíquo.

stepByStep.title: Inserir valores
stepByStep.instruction: Digite as medidas conhecidas nos campos numéricos vazios.

stepByStep.title: Definir unidades
stepByStep.instruction: Escolha a unidade de comprimento e a unidade de volume desejada.

stepByStep.title: Calcular
stepByStep.instruction: Clique em Calcular para visualizar o volume, área superficial e passo a passo detalhado.

workedExample.title: Exemplo Prático: Cilindro com raio 5 cm e altura 10 cm
workedExample.scenario: Calcular o volume e capacidade de um recipiente cilíndrico com r = 5 cm e h = 10 cm.
workedExample.calculation: Área da base A = π × 5² ≈ 78,54 cm². Volume V = 78,54 × 10 = 250π ≈ 785,398 cm³ (0,7854 L).

faqs.question: Qual é a fórmula do volume de um cilindro?
faqs.answer: A fórmula é V = π × r² × h, onde r é o raio da base circular e h é a altura perpendicular.

faqs.question: Como calcular o volume de um cilindro oco (tubo)?
faqs.answer: Subtraia o volume interno do volume externo: V = π × (R² − r²) × h.

ko.shortDescription: 원기둥 부피, 파이프 체적 및 겉넓이를 즉시 계산합니다.
ko.intro: 밑면 반지름과 수직 높이로부터 원기둥의 정확한 3차원 체적 및 리터 단위 환산값을 단계별 풀이와 함께 제공합니다.
ko.formulaDescription: 직원기둥의 부피는 원형 밑면의 넓이에 수직 높이를 곱한 값입니다: V = π × r² × h. 지름 d 사용 시: V = (π × d² × h) / 4. 중공 원통(파이프): V = π × (R² − r²) × h.
ko.formulaEquation: V = π · r² · h  |  V = (π · d² · h) / 4  |  V = π · (R² − r²) · h  |  h = V / (π · r²)

workedExample.title: 계산 예시: 반지름 5cm, 높이 10cm인 원기둥

faqs.question: 원기둥의 부피 공식은 무엇인가요?
faqs.answer: 원기둥의 부피 공식은 V = π × r² × h입니다. 밑면 넓이(πr²)에 수직 높이(h)를 곱합니다.

faqs.question: 파이프(중공 원통)의 부피는 어떻게 구하나요?
faqs.answer: 외부 원기둥 부피에서 내부 원기둥 부피를 뺍니다: V = π × (R² − r²) × h.

it.metaDescription: Calcola il volume di un cilindro da raggio, diametro, altezza, cilindri cavi (tubi) o cilindri obliqui con formule passo dopo passo.
it.description: Calcola il volume di cilindri retti, tubi cavi e ricava altezza e raggio mancanti con passaggi matematici dettagliati.
it.shortDescription: Calcola istantaneamente il volume del cilindro, di tubi cavi e superfici.
it.intro: Calcola con precisione il volume di cilindri retti, tubi cavi e capacità in litri con passaggi analitici completi.
it.formulaDescription: Il volume di un cilindro circolare retto è pari all'area della base circolare moltiplicata per l'altezza perpendicolare: V = π × r² × h. Con il diametro d: V = (π × d² × h) / 4. Per un cilindro cavo: V = π × (R² − r²) × h.
it.formulaEquation: V = π · r² · h  |  V = (π · d² · h) / 4  |  V = π · (R² − r²) · h  |  h = V / (π · r²)

workedExample.title: Esempio svolto: Cilindro con raggio 5 cm e altezza 10 cm
workedExample.scenario: Calcolare il volume e la capacità di un cilindro con r = 5 cm e h = 10 cm.

faqs.question: Qual è la formula del volume di un cilindro?
faqs.answer: La formula è V = π × r² × h, dove r è il raggio della base circolare e h è l'altezza perpendicolare.

faqs.question: Come si calcola il volume di un tubo o cilindro cavo?
faqs.answer: Sottraendo il volume interno dal volume esterno: V = π × (R² − r²) × h.
